item_short_desc: Rothco’s Solid Brass Web Belt Buckle is the perfect accessory for your web belt. Crafted from solid brass, this buckle is designed to withstand daily wear and tear while maintaining its polished look. Measuring 2 1/4 inches in length and 1 3/8 inches in width, it fits perfectly with standard web belts, offering a secure and comfortable fit. The buckle's solid construction ensures durability, making it a reliable choice for both casual and formal occasions.
